item.g:title: Ariella Single Shelf Bedside Table
item.g:description: The Ariella Single Shelf Bedside is a compact bedside table constructed from mango wood with a minimalist contemporary Japanese design. It has an open single shelf and a small footprint intended for use in bedrooms and small spaces, and it requires straightforward assembly. Material: Made from mango wood. Construction: Designed for straightforward assembly with a compact upright form factor and accessible shelf height. Storage/Function: Open single shelf for books or small items and for bedside essentials. Use: Intended for bedside placement in smaller bedrooms and compact sleeping areas. Maintenance: Wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth and avoid abrasive cleaners; dry immediately to prevent moisture damage. The unit measures 60 cm H × 40 cm W × 30 cm D and provides stable, compact storage suitable for bedside organization, conserving floor space while accommodating small personal items.
